rules.title: expect() panic lane
rules.description: expect() converts recoverable failure into an abort. Prefer typed error propagation in protocol code.

rules.title: todo!/unimplemented! in non-test path
rules.description: Unfinished code paths can abort at runtime under production traffic.

rules.title: assert with message-only shape risk
rules.description: Bare assert(true)-style patterns do not constrain witnesses. Confirm the predicate binds private inputs.

rules.title: AccountInfo without CHECK documentation nearby
rules.description: Raw AccountInfo surfaces need explicit ownership/signer documentation and constraints.
